title: Security answers onramp with interactive QnA and cost-triggered credits
creator: Maya Rodriguez
description: Experiment to reduce sales/SE time spent answering SIG/CAIQs by launching an interactive Security Answers onramp in the Console: a guided Q&A assistant that suggests CAIQ responses, auto-populates sections, and optionally bundles a usage-based security-credit when the assistant completes >=65% of the questionnaire. The experiment will test two pricing/packaging levers: (A) one-time 'assisted-response' credit vouchers for enterprise accounts that accelerate contract close, and (B) pay-per-complete-question credits for high-effort questionnaires. We will measure contract velocity, time-to-complete, manual edits after suggestion, and legal/security downstream review load.
acceptance_criteria: Console prototype with interactive Q&A flows and saved-draft per questionnaire section available to beta customers
Event telemetry emitted for start/completion/auto-suggest-apply/edit events (names documented below)
Pricing hook implemented: ability to grant a single-use credit code or apply incremental credits to an account once a completed threshold is met
Baseline metrics captured and dashboard created: time_to_first_answer, percent_auto_suggest_applied, percent_questions_edited_after_apply, contract_close_delta
Legal and Security sign-off on suggested-answer provenance language and audit trail requirements
notes: Rationale: sales and SE teams report 6-12 hours of effort on large SIG/CAIQ requests; small improvements in automation could materially shorten deal cycles for mid-market and up.
Experiment constraints: must retain full audit trail of suggested vs final answers to meet enterprise compliance expectations.

Privacy constraint: suggested answers generated by model must not leak other customer-specific answers; suggestions will be generated from curated internal answer inventory and model completions with strict prompt templates.
